name: orkestra
description: Find appointment-based businesses (salons, barbershops, clinics, spas, auto services and more), check real availability and book, move or cancel appointments.

interface.longDescription:
Orkestra lets you find and book appointments at local businesses that run on Orkestra: hair salons, barbershops, nail studios, spas and massage, fitness studios and personal trainers, medical clinics, auto services, pet grooming, consultants and more.

Ask in plain words, for example "book a haircut in London on Saturday morning". Orkestra searches businesses in the city you name, shows their services, prices and staff, and returns only time slots that are really free in the business's own calendar. Nothing is invented.

Before booking, the assistant confirms the service, date, time and your name, and asks for your phone number and email so the business can reach you. The booking goes straight into the business's calendar and the business is notified. If a business requires a deposit, you get a secure payment link and pay it yourself; the slot is held until you pay.

You can also check the status of a booking, move it to another free time or cancel it, within the rules each business sets (how often and how close to the appointment a booking can be changed, and whether a deposit is refunded).

Orkestra is operated by Digitalbridge IT Solutions S.R.L. Your contact details are shared only with the business you book with.
